name: SATtoColor.SATtoColorSoundness
lines: hcol : ∀ {a b : OutputVertex V}, (ReductionGraph f).Adj a b → (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).Adj (col a) (col b)
hcol : ∀ {a b : OutputVertex V}, (ReductionGraph f).Adj a b → col a ≠ col b
colNe : ∀ {u v : OutputVertex V}, u ≠ v → EdgeRelation f u v ∨ EdgeRelation f v u → col u ≠ col v
hLB : ∀ (l : Literal V), col (OutputVertex.literalNode l) ≠ col (OutputVertex.palette 0)
hPN : ∀ (x : V), col (OutputVertex.literalNode (Literal.pos x)) ≠ col (OutputVertex.literalNode (Literal.neg x))
hG5B : ∀ (c' : Clause V), col (OutputVertex.clauseGadget c' 5) ≠ col (OutputVertex.palette 0)
hG5F : ∀ (c' : Clause V), col (OutputVertex.clauseGadget c' 5) ≠ col (OutputVertex.palette 2)
assign : V → Bool := fun v => decide (col (OutputVertex.literalNode (Literal.pos v)) = col (OutputVertex.palette 1))
∀ (l : Literal V), SatisfiesLiteral assign l = false → col (OutputVertex.literalNode l) ≠ col (OutputVertex.palette 1)
⊢ ∀ (l : Literal V), SatisfiesLiteral assign l = false → col (OutputVertex.literalNode l) ≠ col (OutputVertex.palette 1)
⊢ ∀ x ∈ f, SatisfiesClause assign x = true
hSatF : (SatisfiesLiteral assign c.l1 || SatisfiesLiteral assign c.l2 || SatisfiesLiteral assign c.l3) = false

have colNe : ∀ {u v : OutputVertex V}, u ≠ v → (EdgeRelation f u v ∨ EdgeRelation f v u) → col u ≠ col v :=
  fun hne hedge => hcol ⟨hne, hedge⟩
have hP01 : col (.palette 0) ≠ col (.palette 1) := colNe (by simp) (Or.inl (by simp [EdgeRelation]))

have hPN : ∀ x : V, col (.literalNode (.pos x)) ≠ col (.literalNode (.neg x)) := fun x => colNe (by simp) (Or.inl rfl)
have hG5B : ∀ c' : Clause V, col (.clauseGadget c' 5) ≠ col (.palette 0) := fun c' => colNe (by simp) (Or.inl trivial)
have hG5F : ∀ c' : Clause V, col (.clauseGadget c' 5) ≠ col (.palette 2) := fun c' => colNe (by simp) (Or.inl trivial)
let assign := fun v : V => decide (col (.literalNode (.pos v)) = col (.palette 1))

have hav : col (.literalNode (.pos v)) = col (.palette 1) :=

have hSatF : SatisfiesClause assign c = false := by
  cases h : SatisfiesClause assign c with
  | true => exact absurd h hFalse
